requirements.text: Students should be able to manage book loans and study room bookings online, including searching the catalogue and checking availability.
The fine management process should automatically calculate overdue fines based on a daily rate.
Students should be able to see their current loans, due dates, and any outstanding fines in one place.
Students should receive automated email reminders before their items are due.
Students should be notified immediately when fines are applied to their accounts.
If a student has fines above a certain threshold, they should be blocked from borrowing more items or booking study rooms until those fines are cleared.
Librarians need tools for managing book inventory, including adding new titles, updating existing ones, and retiring materials.
The system should provide meaningful usage reports on loan volumes and study room utilization.
Librarians should have the ability to place holds or restrictions on student accounts if they have outstanding fines.
The system must integrate with the university's student record system to verify student enrollment status.
The system must ensure compliance with GDPR in handling student data.
There must be a smooth migration process from the legacy system to the new one without data loss.
